links.outcome: Manipulation success in steering participants to an incorrect treatment choice, manipulative vs control LLM
links.effect: Manipulation success was 59.5% in the manipulative condition vs 44.0% in control (OR = 2.11, 95% CI [1.12, 4.00], p = .021).
links.quote: Manipulation success rates were higher in the manipulative condition (59.5%) than in the control condition (44.0%), with the effect reaching significance (OR = 2.11, 95% CI [1.12, 4.00], p = .021).

screen.reason: Evaluates user susceptibility to manipulative LLM prompting in a hypothetical clinical scenario rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or guardrail.
